jobs.description:
For an international company operating in the logistics sector, we are looking for a Scrum Master who will play a key role in the organization's ongoing digital transformation, with a strong focus on cloud migration and an AI-driven transformation program.

In this role, you will support multiple Agile teams based in Belgium and internationally while working closely with stakeholders. You will be responsible for facilitating collaboration within and across teams, coaching Agile teams, and removing impediments that may impact delivery.

You will also collaborate with IT partners and business stakeholders on backlog management, prioritization, and ensuring clear communication between business and IT. In addition, you will contribute to dependency management, risk management, and a number of service management activities.

Profile

• You have several years of experience as a Scrum Master within an IT environment.
• You thrive in an international setting and know how to connect and coach teams across different locations and cultures.
• You are proactive, work independently, and actively contribute to strong team collaboration.
• You have excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

In this role you support clients in their digital transformation of their project management processes. You analyze how their projects are structured and managed, and translate this into efficient solutions using specialized tools.
You guide implementations from analysis to implementation, ensuring that systems are aligned with business needs and project realities. You work closely with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, define processes and configure solutions that improve visibility, planning and decision-making.
In this role, you combine project insight with technical understanding, acting as a bridge between engineering, operations and IT. While you work independently on assignments, you also collaborate with colleagues consultants when needed and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Civil or Construction) or Business Engineering
• You have at least a first strong working experience
• Knowledge of Project Management (managing scope, timing & budget...)
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding
• You are fluent in English (additional languages such as Dutch or French are a plus)

In this role you support big clients in improving the way they plan, monitor and manage complex technical projects. You work on project controls topics such as scheduling, progress tracking, reporting, forecasting, risk follow-up and performance insights.
You help structure project data, improve processes and support the implementation or optimization of project management tools. You do not need to know all tools from day one: the company provides strong internal training and guidance.
You work closely with project teams, consultants and client stakeholders to translate project information into clear insights and actionable improvements. Depending on the project, you may also contribute to dashboards, BI reporting and data-driven decision-making. This is a role for someone who combines an interest in technical projects with the ability to understand digital tools and process optimization.

• Master’s degree, preferably in Engineering (civil, industrial, mechanical, construction) or Business Engineering
• You have at least a first strong working experience
• Knowledge of Project Controls
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding
• You are fluent in English (additional languages such as Dutch or French are a plus)

Sector: Banking / Financial Services

Our client, a major player in the Belgian financial services sector, is looking for an experienced Project Manager to drive forward a strategic action plan aimed at strengthening risk culture across the organization. The role sits at the intersection of governance, risk management, and IT, and requires someone comfortable coordinating stakeholders across business and technical teams.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end management of the action plan: planning, tracking, reporting, and stakeholder alignment

• Coordinate with business, risk, compliance, and IT stakeholders to ensure initiatives are implemented on time and within scope

• Translate risk culture objectives into concrete, actionable workstreams

• Monitor progress against KPIs and prepare steering committee reporting

• Identify risks and roadblocks in execution and propose mitigation actions

• Ensure alignment with the bank's broader risk management framework and regulatory expectations

• Act as a bridge between risk/business teams and IT teams on risk-related technology initiatives

Nice to have

• Familiarity with risk culture frameworks or change management methodologies

• Prior experience in a similar action-plan / transformation program

• 5+ years of experience in project management within the banking or financial services sector

• Solid understanding of risk management (operational, non-financial, or IT risk)

• Experience working on IT risk topics or IT-related risk projects is a strong plus

• Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior business and IT stakeholders

• Excellent organizational and reporting skills; structured, autonomous, and results-driven

• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with good working English

• PMP, Prince2, or similar certification is an asset

HEIMWEE is looking for Supply Chain Management interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Supply Chain Management Intern to join us on-site and help keep production and logistics running smoothly across our three brands. From fabric to furniture, you'll get hands-on exposure to how a multi-brand company sources materials, coordinates production, and gets finished products to customers on time.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Support day-to-day coordination with suppliers and production partners across our brands 

• Help track purchase orders, lead times, and delivery schedules 

• Monitor stock levels and assist with inventory planning to avoid shortages or overstock 

• Support the coordination of shipments and logistics, both inbound (materials) and outbound (orders to customers) 

• Help identify bottlenecks in the supply chain and suggest improvements 

• Maintain accurate records of suppliers, orders, and stock 

• Work closely with the operations, marketing, and customer service teams to align on product availability  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying supply chain management, logistics, business, or a related field 

• Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and spreadsheets 

• Interest in production and sourcing, ideally in fashion and/or furniture 

• Proactive problem-solver who's comfortable coordinating with multiple parties 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility and visibility into how products move from supplier to customer 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

Experience in building applications for web, mobile, desktop, or gaming? You’ll be familiar with .NET by Microsoft. This open-source, cross-platform framework (compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux) supports various programming languages, including the ever-popular C#. Thanks to its high-performance runtime, consistent programming model, and extensive library of precoded solutions .NET enables us to incorporate performance, security, reliability, and productivity into our solutions. 

Pave the way for AI innovations, cloud adoption and digital transformation with Microsoft Azure’s suite of virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases. Problem-solving, collaboration with crossfunctional teams and designing scalable solutions are going to be your key skills as an Azure expert. You’ll also familiarise yourself with Azure Active Directory, monitoring tools, and cost management to deliver the continuous integration and delivery, as well as implementing security best practices, quality and compliance that Sopra Steria is known for.  

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

Profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• .NET
• Typescript
• API design
• Security
• Azure services (Azure Functions/App Services, Azure IoT Hub, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Services…)
• OO
• SOLID principles
• Design patterns 
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• Languages: English, and Dutch or French required

jobs.occupation: Fulltime Kitchen Crew Member - Brussels Center
jobs.description:
Do you like the smell of freshly prepared food, the buzz of a packed venue, and the idea of working where people come to enjoy great beers and good times? Then keep reading.
 

At 
Bier Central Brussels, we're looking for a 
full-time Kitchen Crew Member to strengthen our team. We're not searching for the next Michelin-star chef (unless you secretly are one), but we are looking for someone who enjoys working in a professional kitchen, loves a lively atmosphere, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves when things get busy.
 

 
 

What you'll be doing:
 
 

• Helping prepare our delicious dishes. 

• Keeping the kitchen organized, clean, and efficient. 

• Working closely with an enthusiastic team that knows how to work hard and laugh even harder. 

• Delivering quality dishes, even when the restaurant is packed and the beer is flowing. 

* You already have some experience in a professional kitchen.
 

* You can communicate comfortably in 
English. If you speak additional languages, that's a huge bonus. 
 

* You live 
in or near Brussels city centre. Let's be honest: relying on public transport after a late closing shift is not always the happiest part of the job.
 

* You actually 
enjoy weekend work. While most people are planning their weekend, you'll be right in the middle of the action, the atmosphere, and the excitement. Those are our busiest and most fun moments.
 

* You bring a positive attitude, team spirit, and a willingness to learn.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the enterprise-wide data architecture that supports critical business initiatives and drives data-driven decision-making. You'll shape the structure, governance, and strategic roadmap of data assets across the organization¿ensuring data is accessible, secure, integrated, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You'll collaborate with senior stakeholders in IT, analytics, and the business to architect scalable data solutions across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments¿balancing innovation with long-term sustainability.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve enterprise data architecture, aligning with business strategies and regulatory requirements.
• Lead data modelling efforts across operational and analytical domains (OLTP/OLAP), including conceptual, logical, and physical models.
• Promote a hands-on, pragmatic approach towards data architecture and the overall team dynamic
• Define and implement data standards, policies, and governance frameworks.
• Guide the architecture of data platforms, support self-service, AI, Dashboarding and real-time streaming solutions.
• Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, Architects, and Business stakeholders to ensure data quality, accessibility, and lineage.
• Influence senior stakeholders and business owners across the organisation (38K, global)
• Evaluate and recommend technologies and tools for data integration, storage, cataloguing, and analytics.
• Ensure data architecture enables AI/ML, advanced analytics, and reporting initiatives.
• Support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, or other regulatory standards depending on the region/industry.
• Provide architectural oversight and leadership across data-related projects and programs.
• Mentor junior data architects and engineers, contributing to a strong data architecture community. 
We do not only deliver letters and parcels, but also opportunities. This job is open to all with diverse backgrounds and talents, possessing the following profile:  
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in large scale data architecture or related fields (over 100m events); 3+ years in a senior or enterprise role.
• Strong hands-on expertise in data architecture design for cloud (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid environments.
• Deep knowledge of data modelling techniques, ETL/ELT pipelines, automation (CICD scripting, Airflow...) and data lifecycle management.
• Experience with streaming data is a strong asset (Kafka, Flink...). Experience with Semantic integration and Ontology also assets.
• Familiarity with modern data stacks: Snowflake, Databricks, DBT, etc.
• Understanding of data security, master data management (MDM), data mesh, and metadata management.
• Excellent communication (business fluent English, French and/or Dutch are a plus) and leadership skills with the ability to translate complex data topics for business audiences.
• Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments is a plus.
• 2 days per week (minimum) hybrid office presence. 
Like a long-awaited parcel, we want to make you feel welcome and valued. Our offer includes:  

·       Competitive monthly salary 

·       Meal vouchers 

·       Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances 

·       A phone subscription and company car 

·       20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off  

·       An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay  

·       Many benefits from more than 100 bpost-partners 

 

Why bpostgroup? 

bpostgroup is Belgium's leading postal operator and a growing parcel & omni-commerce logistics partner globally. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, we aim to be a trusted guide in a changing world. As our newest team member you will:  

·       Become part of the bpostgroup family with a unique atmosphere and culture. 

·       Enjoy a dynamic work environment with a hybrid model allowing for flexibility. 

·       Have access to continuous learning and development opportunities. 

·       Have a direct impact on decision-making in an international success story. 

·       Thrive in a leadership culture centered on visioning, sense making, innovation, and relating, empowering you to lead effectively in our forward-thinking organization.  

Find out more about bpostgroup

• You research new applications and functionality for business use cases
• You build new processes as well as optimize existing ones
• You rollout the template to new factories and countries
• You work closely together with the business process owners
• You participate in the blueprint and fit-gap
• You understand the business processes and requirements
• You convert them into a functional design
• You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications
• You document and test the functionality
• You support the business during acceptance and go-live
• You play a key role in all phases from the beginning till the end

• You have built up profound knowledge of SAP SD (sales and distribution)

• You work independently and collaborate in dialogue with colleagues

• Act as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
